---
name: Mobile app development
description: Guidelines for mobile app development
applyTo: apps/mobile/**/*
---
- Use NativeWind for styling
- Use Expo
- Keep code clean, DRY, and well organized
- Use Lucide icons for React Native
- Search for and reuse existing components whenever possible. Do not create a new component unless you are sure a suitable one does not exist.
- Avoid making any major updates outside of the scope of the request
- Don't change the UI design unless requested to do so
- Follow existing UI design patterns on other screens
- Use optimistic UI and avoid unnecessary loading states
- Always use native navigation UI (headers, titles, search, etc.)
